<summary>
Task: produce /root/pred_instructions.json (egomotion labels per sampled-frame interval at fps=5) and /root/pred_dyn_masks.npz (per-frame binary masks in CSR sparse format with "shape" key).

Turn 1: Probed video with OpenCV: 207 frames @ 60 fps, 720×1280, duration 3.45s. With target fps=5 → step=12, giving 18 sampled frames (indices 0,12,24,...,204).

Turn 2: Created /root/solve.py that (a) samples 18 frames, (b) estimates per-pair partial 2D affine (RANSAC over LK-tracked goodFeaturesToTrack) to derive dx, dy, rot, scale for egomotion labeling, (c) merges consecutive identical label lists into "start->end" intervals in JSON, and (d) computes dynamic masks by warping prev to curr and thresholding absdiff. Sign conventions: scale>1→"Dolly In"; rot>0→"Roll Right"; dx>0→"Pan Left" (else "Pan Right"); dy>0→"Tilt Up" (else "Tilt Down"). Thresholds: TH_TRANS=8, TH_ROT=1°, TH_SCALE=0.01.

Turn 3: First run. Egomotion result (kept unchanged across later iterations):
  "0->3": ["Stay"], "3->6": ["Pan Right"], "6->18": ["Dolly In","Pan Right"].
Frame-by-frame values show consistent dx≈−20..−25 (rightward camera pan), small dy, rot near 0, scale≈1.01–1.02 (mild dolly in). Frame 10 is an outlier with dx=−40, dy=−24, scale=1.06 (likely a bad affine fit / motion spike). Dynamic masks in this version were far too large (12–19% of image per frame), indicating misalignment/parallax bleed rather than real dynamic content.

Turn 4-5: Rewrote mask block to use per-pair full homography (findHomography from dense LK tracks), Gaussian-blurred difference, MAD-based threshold (max(25, med+4.5·1.4826·MAD)), eroded valid region, larger morphology (open k3, close k11), MIN_AREA≈1840 px. Re-ran: masks got worse (14–22%), confirming absdiff approach is fundamentally noisy for this parallax-heavy scene.

Turn 6-9: Saved sample source frames (0,60,120,204) and inspected frame_0.jpg and frame_120.jpg to understand the scene (details of the scene not captured explicitly here beyond visual inspection).

Turn 10: Replaced masking approach with Farneback dense optical flow + robust IRLS Tukey-biweight affine flow model fit on 8-px grid; per-pixel residual flow magnitude thresholded via median+5·1.4826·MAD (floor 3.0). Morphology open k5, close k15; MIN_AREA≈max(1500, 0.003·H·W)≈2765 px.

Turn 11: Re-ran. Masks now sparse and plausible:
  f1:1.10%, f2:0%, f3:0%, f4:2.43%, f5:1.24%, f6:9.34%, f7:3.27%, f8:1.82%, f9:1.23%, f10–17:0%. Frame 0 mask is 0 by design (no prior frame). Egomotion output unchanged.

Turn 12-15: Built /root/viz.py to overlay predicted masks (frames k=4,6,7) on source frames as red overlays. Ran viz (nnz confirmed: 22369, 86110, 30122). Viewed overlay_6.jpg (largest mask, ~9.3%). Content of the overlay not yet described in this window — the analysis of whether the mask covers the intended dynamic object(s) is pending in the next window.

State entering next chunk:
- /root/pred_instructions.json exists with the merged intervals above.
- /root/pred_dyn_masks.npz exists in required CSR format with keys "shape", "f_{i}_data/indices/indptr" for i=0..17.
- The agent is currently validating the dynamic-mask quality visually and may further tune thresholds. No terminal "cannot finish" signal has been emitted; the agent believes the task is feasible and is iterating on quality.
</summary>
